1→#!/bin/bash
     2→set -euo pipefail
     3→
     4→# ============================================================
     5→# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
     6→# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
     7→# ============================================================
     8→
     9→PLUGIN_NAME="cowave-devtools"
    10→MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
    11→GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
    12→CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
    13→PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
    14→MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
    15→CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
    16→KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
    17→INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
    18→SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
    19→
    20→RED='\033[0;31m'
    21→GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    22→YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
    23→BLUE='\033[0;34m'
    24→NC='\033[0m'
    25→
    26→info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
    27→ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
    28→warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
    29→error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }
    30→
    31→# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
    32→check_prerequisites() {
    33→    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
    34→        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    35→    fi
    36→    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    37→        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    38→    fi
    39→    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
    40→        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    41→    fi
    42→}
    43→
    44→# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
    45→prepare_dirs() {
    46→    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"
    47→
    48→    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
    49→        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    50→    fi
    51→    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
    52→        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    53→    fi
    54→}
    55→
    56→# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
    57→clone_or_update() {
    58→    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
    59→        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
    60→        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    61→        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
    62→            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
    63→            cd /
    64→            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    65→            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    66→        }
    67→    else
    68→        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
    69→        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    70→        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    71→    fi
    72→    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    73→}
    74→
    75→# --- 캐시 디렉토리에 플러그인 배치 ---
    76→install_to_cache() {
    77→    local commit_sha
    78→    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    79→    local version="$commit_sha"
    80→
    81→    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    82→    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"
    83→
    84→    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    85→    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    86→    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    87→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    88→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    89→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    90→
    91→    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    92→    echo "$version"
    93→}
    94→
    95→# --- known_marketplaces.json 등록 ---
    96→register_marketplace() {
    97→    local now
    98→    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    99→
   100→    local updated
   101→    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
   102→        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
   103→        --arg now "$now" \
   104→        '.[$name] = {
   105→            "source": {
   106→                "source": "gitlab",
   107→                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
   108→            },
   109→            "installLocation": $location,
   110→            "lastUpdated": $now
   111→        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")
   112→
   113→    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
   114→    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
   115→}
   116→
   117→# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
   118→register_plugin() {
   119→    local version="$1"
   120→    local now
   121→    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
   122→    local commit_sha
   123→    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
   124→    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"
   125→
   126→    local updated
   127→    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
   128→        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
   129→        --arg ver "$version" \
   130→        --arg now "$now" \
   131→        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
   132→        '.plugins[$key] = [{
   133→            "scope": "user",
   134→            "installPath": $path,
   135→            "version": $ver,
   136→            "installedAt": $now,

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="cowave-devtools"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    fi
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
prepare_dirs() {
    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"

    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    fi
}

# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
clone_or_update() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
            cd /
            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        }
    else
        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    fi
    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
}

# --- 캐시 디렉토리에 플러그인 배치 ---
install_to_cache() {
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    local version="$commit_sha"

    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"

    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    echo "$version"
}

# --- known_marketplaces.json 등록 ---
register_marketplace() {
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        '.[$name] = {
            "source": {
                "source": "gitlab",
                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
            },
            "installLocation": $location,
            "lastUpdated": $now
        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")

    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
}

# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
register_plugin() {
    local version="$1"
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
        --arg ver "$version" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
        '.plugins[$key] = [{
            "scope": "user",
            "installPath": $path,
            "version": $ver,
            "installedAt": $now,
            "lastUpdated": $now,
            "gitCommitSha": $sha
        }]' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")

    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    ok "플러그인 등록 완료: $plugin_key"
}

# --- settings.json에 플러그인 활성화 ---
activate_plugin() {
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    local is_active
    is_active=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$SETTINGS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$is_active" = "true" ]; then
        info "이미 활성화되어 있습니다."
    else
        local updated
        updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] = true' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
        echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
        ok "플러그인 활성화 완료"
    fi
}

# --- 환경변수 확인 ---
check_env_vars() {
    echo ""
    info "환경변수 설정을 확인합니다..."

    local missing=()

    [ -z "${PLANE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("PLANE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${OUTLINE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("OUTLINE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN:-}" ] && missing+=("GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN")

    if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        warn "다음 환경변수가 설정되지 않았습니다:"
        for var in "${missing[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        info "~/.zshrc 또는 ~/.bashrc에 다음을 추가하세요:"
        echo ""
        echo "  export PLANE_API_KEY=\"your-plane-api-key\""
        echo "  export OUTLINE_API_KEY=\"your-outline-api-key\""
        echo "  export GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"your-grafana-token\""
        echo ""
        info "API 키 발급 방법:"
        echo "  - Plane: https://project.cowave.kr → 프로필 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Outline: https://cowave.wiki.cowave.kr → 설정 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Grafana: http://grafana.danuricorp.com → Administration → Service Accounts"
    else
        ok "모든 환경변수가 설정되어 있습니다."
    fi
}

# --- 메인 ---
main() {
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Cowave Claude Plugin 설치"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    check_prerequisites
    prepare_dirs
    clone_or_update

    local version
    version=$(install_to_cache)

    register_marketplace
    register_plugin "$version"
    activate_plugin
    check_env_vars

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}설치 완료!${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
    info "Claude Code를 재시작하면 플러그인이 활성화됩니다."
    info "사용 가능한 기능:"
    echo "  - /issue-tracker      : Plane 이슈 트래커 연동"
    echo "  - /document-lastest   : Outline 위키 자동 문서화"
    echo "  - /tdd                : TDD 워크플로우"
    echo "  - /arch-review        : 아키텍처 리뷰"
    echo "  - /perf-review        : 성능 리뷰"
    echo "  - /e2e                : E2E 테스트"
    echo "  - MCP: plane, outline, grafana 서버 연동"
    echo ""
}

main "$@"

#!/bin/bash

# Session start time tracking file
SESSION_FILE="$HOME/.claude/statusline-session.txt"
USAGE_CACHE_FILE="$HOME/.claude/statusline-usage-cache.json"
USAGE_CACHE_TTL=120  # seconds

# Read JSON input from stdin
input=$(cat)

# Extract data from JSON
session_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // ""')
model_display=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"')
model_id=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.id // ""')
total_input=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0')
total_output=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0')
used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')
remaining_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty')
cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // ""')
# Extract model name, version
# model_id examples: claude-opus-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-3-5
model_name="Claude"
model_version=""
if echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "opus"; then
    model_name="Opus"
    model_color=$'\033[91m'  # Bright Red
elif echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "sonnet"; then
    model_name="Sonnet"
    model_color=$'\033[94m'  # Bright Blue
elif echo "$model_display" | grep -qi "haiku"; then
    model_name="Haiku"
    model_color=$'\033[32m'  # Green
else
    model_color=$'\033[37m'  # White
fi

# Extract version from model_id (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6 -> 4.6, claude-opus-4-5 -> 4.5)
if [ -n "$model_id" ]; then
    # Match trailing digits pattern like -4-6 or -3-5 at end of model id
    raw_version=$(echo "$model_id" | grep -oE '[0-9]+-[0-9]+$')
    if [ -n "$raw_version" ]; then
        model_version=$(echo "$raw_version" | sed 's/-/./')
    fi
fi

# Build model label: "Sonnet 4.6 high" or "Opus 4.5 medium"
model_label="${model_name}"
[ -n "$model_version" ] && model_label="${model_label} ${model_version}"

# Append effort level only for non-Haiku models
if [ "$model_name" != "Haiku" ]; then
    effort=$(jq -r '.effortLevel // empty' $HOME/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null)
    # Normalize effort: if empty, "default", or anything other than "high"/"low" -> "medium"
    if [ "$effort" = "high" ]; then
        effort_label="high"
    elif [ "$effort" = "low" ]; then
        effort_label="low"
    else
        effort_label="medium"
    fi
    model_label="${model_label} ${effort_label}"
fi

reset=$'\033[0m'
dim_gray=$'\033[90m'
bright_white=$'\033[97m'
bright_yellow=$'\033[93m'
bright_green=$'\033[92m'
bright_red=$'\033[91m'
bright_blue=$'\033[94m'
bright_cyan=$'\033[96m'
bold_red=$'\033[1;31m'

# === Usage API (5h/7d rate limits) with file-based caching ===
refresh_usage_cache() {
    local now=$(date +%s)
    local creds
    creds=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s "Claude Code-credentials" -w 2>/dev/null)
    [ -z "$creds" ] && return 1

    local token
    token=$(echo "$creds" | jq -r '.claudeAiOauth.accessToken // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    [ -z "$token" ] && return 1

    local response
    response=$(curl -s --max-time 3 \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" \
        -H "anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20" \
        "https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -z "$response" ] && return 1

    local five_hour seven_day
    five_hour=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.five_hour.utilization // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    seven_day=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.seven_day.utilization // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    [ -z "$five_hour" ] && return 1

    local five_hour_reset seven_day_reset
    five_hour_reset=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.five_hour.resets_at // empty' 2>/dev/null)
    seven_day_reset=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.seven_day.resets_at // empty' 2>/dev/null)

    printf '{"timestamp":%d,"five_hour":%s,"seven_day":%s,"five_hour_reset":"%s","seven_day_reset":"%s"}\n' \
        "$now" "$five_hour" "$seven_day" "$five_hour_reset" "$seven_day_reset" > "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE"
}

get_usage() {
    local now=$(date +%s)
    local need_refresh=1

    if [ -f "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" ]; then
        local cache_time
        cache_time=$(jq -r '.timestamp // 0' "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
        local age=$(( now - cache_time ))
        [ "$age" -lt "$USAGE_CACHE_TTL" ] && need_refresh=0
    fi

    [ "$need_refresh" -eq 1 ] && refresh_usage_cache

    if [ -f "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE" ]; then
        cat "$USAGE_CACHE_FILE"
    else
        echo '{}'
    fi
}

usage_json=$(get_usage)
five_hour=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.five_hour // "-"' 2>/dev/null)
seven_day=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.seven_day // "-"' 2>/dev/null)
five_hour_reset=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.five_hour_reset // ""' 2>/dev/null)
seven_day_reset=$(echo "$usage_json" | jq -r '.seven_day_reset // ""' 2>/dev/null)

# Format ISO 8601 reset time as absolute local time (e.g., "14:30", "3/9 14:30")
format_reset_time() {
    local reset_at=$1
    [ -z "$reset_at" ] || [ "$reset_at" = "null" ] || [ "$reset_at" = "" ] && return

    # Strip fractional seconds and timezone suffix, parse as UTC
    local clean=$(echo "$reset_at" | sed -E 's/\.[0-9]+(Z|\+[0-9:]+)$//' | sed 's/Z$//' | sed 's/+00:00$//')
    local reset_epoch=$(TZ=UTC date -j -f "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" "$clean" "+%s" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -z "$reset_epoch" ] && return

    local now=$(date +%s)
    [ "$reset_epoch" -le "$now" ] && printf "now" && return

    # Compare dates: if same day, show only HH:MM; otherwise show M/D HH:MM
    local today=$(date +%Y%m%d)
    local reset_day=$(date -r "$reset_epoch" +%Y%m%d)

    if [ "$today" = "$reset_day" ]; then
        date -r "$reset_epoch" "+%H:%M"
    else
        date -r "$reset_epoch" "+%-m/%-d %H:%M"
    fi
}

# Build a colored progress bar for usage (same style as context bar)
make_usage_bar() {
    local label=$1
    local val=$2
    local reset_at=$3
    local bw=10

    local int_val=0
    if [ "$val" != "-" ] && [ "$val" != "null" ]; then
        int_val=$(printf "%.0f" "$val" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
    fi

    # Color based on usage
    local bar_color
    if [ "$int_val" -lt 50 ]; then
        bar_color=$'\033[32m'  # Green
    elif [ "$int_val" -lt 80 ]; then
        bar_color=$'\033[33m'  # Yellow
    else
        bar_color=$'\033[31m'  # Red
    fi

    local f=$(( int_val * bw / 100 ))
    [ "$f" -lt 0 ] && f=0
    [ "$f" -gt "$bw" ] && f=$bw
    local e=$(( bw - f ))

    local bar_f="" bar_e=""
    for ((i=0; i<f; i++)); do bar_f="${bar_f}█"; done
    for ((i=0; i<e; i++)); do bar_e="${bar_e}░"; done

    local reset_label=""
    if [ -n "$reset_at" ] && [ "$reset_at" != "null" ]; then
        local rt=$(format_reset_time "$reset_at")
        [ -n "$rt" ] && reset_label=$(printf " ${bright_white}(%s)${reset}" "$rt")
    fi

    printf "${bright_white}%s${reset} ${bar_color}%s${dim_gray}%s${reset} ${bright_white}%d%%${reset}%s" \
        "$label" "$bar_f" "$bar_e" "$int_val" "$reset_label"
}

five_hour_bar=$(make_usage_bar "5h" "$five_hour" "$five_hour_reset")
seven_day_bar=$(make_usage_bar "7d" "$seven_day" "$seven_day_reset")

# Get current folder name
folder_name=$(basename "$cwd")

# Get git branch and detect worktree
cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || cd "$HOME"
git_branch=""
is_worktree=0
main_repo_name=""
worktree_dir_name=""
if git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    git_branch=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "")

    # Detect if current directory is a linked worktree
    # Main worktree path is the first entry of `git worktree list`
    main_wt_path=$(git worktree list 2>/dev/null | head -1 | awk '{print $1}')
    current_toplevel=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$main_wt_path" ] && [ -n "$current_toplevel" ] && [ "$current_toplevel" != "$main_wt_path" ]; then
        is_worktree=1
        main_repo_name=$(basename "$main_wt_path")
        worktree_dir_name=$(basename "$current_toplevel")
    fi
fi

# Extract context window size and current input tokens
ctx_window_size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 0')
current_input=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // empty')

# Format context window size (e.g., 200000 -> 200k, 1000000 -> 1m)
format_ctx_size() {
    local size=$1
    if [ "$size" -ge 1000000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $size / 1000000" | bc)m"
    elif [ "$size" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $size / 1000" | bc)k"
    else
        echo "${size}"
    fi
}

# Format token count in k (e.g., 40000 -> 40k, 15500 -> 15k)
format_tokens_k() {
    local tokens=$1
    if [ "$tokens" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "$(echo "scale=0; $tokens / 1000" | bc)k"
    else
        echo "${tokens}"
    fi
}

ctx_size_label=$(format_ctx_size "$ctx_window_size")

# Build context usage label: "40k/200k" or "200k"
if [ -n "$current_input" ] && [ "$current_input" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    used_label=$(format_tokens_k "$current_input")
    ctx_usage_label="${used_label}/${ctx_size_label}"
else
    ctx_usage_label="${ctx_size_label}"
fi

# Create progress bar: filled blocks + empty blocks
# Always show percentage; default to 0% when used_pct is absent (session start)
bar_width=10
used_int=$(printf "%.0f" "${used_pct:-0}" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
filled=$(( used_int * bar_width / 100 ))
[ "$filled" -lt 0 ] && filled=0
[ "$filled" -gt "$bar_width" ] && filled=$bar_width
empty_chars=$(( bar_width - filled ))

# Color based on usage (green when 0% too)
if [ "$used_int" -lt 50 ]; then
    ctx_color=$'\033[32m'  # Green
elif [ "$used_int" -lt 75 ]; then
    ctx_color=$'\033[33m'  # Yellow
else
    ctx_color=$'\033[31m'  # Red
fi

bar_filled=""
bar_empty=""
for ((i=0; i<filled; i++)); do bar_filled="${bar_filled}█"; done
for ((i=0; i<empty_chars; i++)); do bar_empty="${bar_empty}░"; done

progress_bar=$(printf "${bright_white}Context${reset} ${ctx_color}%s${dim_gray}%s${reset} ${bright_white}${used_int}%%${reset} | ${bright_white}%s${reset}" "$bar_filled" "$bar_empty" "$ctx_usage_label")

# Line 1: Robot icon + Model | Progress bar | context usage
# U+1F916 ROBOT FACE in UTF-8: F0 9F A4 96
robot=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\xA4\x96')
line1=$(printf "%s ${model_color}%s${reset} | %s" "$robot" "$model_label" "$progress_bar")

# Icons for line 2
# U+1F4C1 OPEN FILE FOLDER in UTF-8: F0 9F 93 81
icon_dir=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\x93\x81')
# U+E0A0 POWERLINE BRANCH SYMBOL in UTF-8: EE 82 A0
icon_branch=$(printf '\xEE\x82\xA0')
# U+1F33F HERB (worktree) in UTF-8: F0 9F 8C BF
icon_worktree=$(printf '\xF0\x9F\x8C\xBF')

# Line 2: Directory | Git branch
# If in a linked worktree: show "📁 main-repo | 🌿 worktree-dir"
# Otherwise: show "📁 current-dir"
if [ "$is_worktree" -eq 1 ]; then
    line2=$(printf "%s ${bright_yellow}%s${reset} | %s ${bright_green}%s${reset}" "$icon_dir" "$main_repo_name" "$icon_worktree" "$worktree_dir_name")
else
    line2=$(printf "%s ${bright_yellow}%s${reset}" "$icon_dir" "$folder_name")
fi
if [ -n "$git_branch" ]; then
    # Color branch by type
    branch_color="$bright_white"
    if [ "$git_branch" = "master" ] || [ "$git_branch" = "main" ]; then
        branch_color="$bright_red"
    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^develop"; then
        branch_color="$bright_blue"
    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^feat" || echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^feature"; then
        branch_color="$bright_cyan"
    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^release"; then
        branch_color="$bright_yellow"
    elif echo "$git_branch" | grep -q "^hotfix"; then
        branch_color="$bold_red"
    elif [ "$is_worktree" -eq 1 ]; then
        branch_color="$bright_green"
    fi
    line2=$(printf "%s | %s ${branch_color}%s${reset}" "$line2" "$icon_branch" "$git_branch")

    # Git file change stats (added/modified/deleted)
    git_status=$(git -c core.useBuiltinFSMonitor=false -c core.fsmonitor=false status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$git_status" ]; then
        added=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^??\|^A \|^A[MD]')
        modified=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^ M\|^M \|^MM\|^AM\|^R ')
        deleted=$(echo "$git_status" | grep -c '^ D\|^D \|^MD')

        git_changes=""
        [ "$added" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_green}+${added}${reset}"
        [ "$modified" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_yellow}~${modified}${reset}"
        [ "$deleted" -gt 0 ] && git_changes="${git_changes} ${bright_red}-${deleted}${reset}"
        [ -n "$git_changes" ] && line2=$(printf "%s |%s" "$line2" "$git_changes")
    fi
fi

# Append usage bars to line 1
line1=$(printf "%s | ${bright_white}Usage${reset} %s | %s" "$line1" "$five_hour_bar" "$seven_day_bar")

# Output both lines
printf "%s\n%s" "$line1" "$line2"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="cowave-devtools"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    fi
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
prepare_dirs() {
    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"

    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    fi
}

# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
clone_or_update() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
            cd /
            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        }
    else
        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    fi
    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
}

# --- 캐시 디렉토리에 플러그인 배치 ---
install_to_cache() {
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    local version="$commit_sha"

    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"

    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    echo "$version"
}

# --- known_marketplaces.json 등록 ---
register_marketplace() {
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        '.[$name] = {
            "source": {
                "source": "gitlab",
                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
            },
            "installLocation": $location,
            "lastUpdated": $now
        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")

    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
}

# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
register_plugin() {
    local version="$1"
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
        --arg ver "$version" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
        '.plugins[$key] = [{
            "scope": "user",
            "installPath": $path,
            "version": $ver,
            "installedAt": $now,
            "lastUpdated": $now,
            "gitCommitSha": $sha
        }]' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")

    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    ok "플러그인 등록 완료: $plugin_key"
}

# --- settings.json에 플러그인 활성화 ---
activate_plugin() {
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    local is_active
    is_active=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$SETTINGS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$is_active" = "true" ]; then
        info "이미 활성화되어 있습니다."
    else
        local updated
        updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] = true' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
        echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
        ok "플러그인 활성화 완료"
    fi
}

# --- 환경변수 확인 ---
check_env_vars() {
    echo ""
    info "환경변수 설정을 확인합니다..."

    local missing=()

    [ -z "${PLANE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("PLANE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${OUTLINE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("OUTLINE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN:-}" ] && missing+=("GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN")

    if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        warn "다음 환경변수가 설정되지 않았습니다:"
        for var in "${missing[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        info "~/.zshrc 또는 ~/.bashrc에 다음을 추가하세요:"
        echo ""
        echo "  export PLANE_API_KEY=\"your-plane-api-key\""
        echo "  export OUTLINE_API_KEY=\"your-outline-api-key\""
        echo "  export GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"your-grafana-token\""
        echo ""
        info "API 키 발급 방법:"
        echo "  - Plane: https://project.cowave.kr → 프로필 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Outline: https://cowave.wiki.cowave.kr → 설정 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Grafana: http://grafana.danuricorp.com → Administration → Service Accounts"
    else
        ok "모든 환경변수가 설정되어 있습니다."
    fi
}

# --- 메인 ---
main() {
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Cowave Claude Plugin 설치"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    check_prerequisites
    prepare_dirs
    clone_or_update

    local version
    version=$(install_to_cache)

    register_marketplace
    register_plugin "$version"
    activate_plugin
    check_env_vars

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}설치 완료!${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
    info "Claude Code를 재시작하면 플러그인이 활성화됩니다."
    info "사용 가능한 기능:"
    echo "  - /issue-tracker      : Plane 이슈 트래커 연동"
    echo "  - /document-lastest   : Outline 위키 자동 문서화"
    echo "  - /tdd                : TDD 워크플로우"
    echo "  - /arch-review        : 아키텍처 리뷰"
    echo "  - /perf-review        : 성능 리뷰"
    echo "  - /e2e                : E2E 테스트"
    echo "  - MCP: plane, outline, grafana 서버 연동"
    echo ""
}

main "$@"

install_claude_settings() {
    local src_dir="$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude"

    # 1. 기존 settings.json 백업
    if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        local backup="${SETTINGS_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"
        cp "$SETTINGS_FILE" "$backup"
        ok "설정 백업 완료: $backup"
    else
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    # 2. hooks 머지 (hooks.json → settings.json)
    merge_hooks "$src_dir/hooks/hooks.json"

    # 3. output-styles 복사
    if [ -d "$src_dir/output-styles" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles"
        cp -r "$src_dir/output-styles/"* "$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles/" 2>/dev/null || true
        ok "output-styles 복사 완료"
    fi

    # 4. statusline 복사
    if [ -f "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" ]; then
        cp "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" "$CLAUDE_DIR/statusline-command.sh"
        ok "statusline 복사 완료"
    fi

    # 5. statusLine 설정 등록
    merge_statusline

    # 6. CLAUDE.md 병합
    merge_claude_md "$src_dir/CLAUDE.md"
}

# --- hooks 머지 (description 기준 중복 방지) ---
merge_hooks() {
    local hooks_file="$1"

    if [ ! -f "$hooks_file" ]; then
        warn "hooks.json을 찾을 수 없습니다: $hooks_file"
        return
    fi

    local src_hooks
    src_hooks=$(jq '.hooks' "$hooks_file")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --argjson src "$src_hooks" '
        reduce ($src | to_entries[]) as $event (
            .;
            reduce $event.value[] as $hook (
                .;
                if ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) | map(.description) | index($hook.description)) then
                    .
                else
                    .hooks[$event.key] = ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) + [$hook])
                end
            )
        )
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "hooks 머지 완료 (중복 건너뜀)"
}

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg cmd "bash $HOME/.claude/statusline-command.sh" '

            "type": "command",
            "command": $cmd
        }
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    fi
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
prepare_dirs() {
    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"

    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    fi
}

# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
clone_or_update() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
            cd /
            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        }
    else
        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    fi
    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
}

install_to_cache() {
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    local version="$commit_sha"

    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    fi
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
prepare_dirs() {
    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"

    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    fi
}

# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
clone_or_update() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
            cd /
            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        }
    else
        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"

install_to_cache() {
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    local version="$commit_sha"

    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"

    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    echo "$version"
}

register_marketplace() {
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        '.[$name] = {
            "source": {
                "source": "gitlab",
                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
            },
            "installLocation": $location,
            "lastUpdated": $now
        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")

    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
}

# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
register_plugin() {
    local version="$1"
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
        --arg ver "$version" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
        '.plugins[$key] = [{
            "scope": "user",
            "installPath": $path,
            "version": $ver,
            "installedAt": $now,
            "lastUpdated": $now,
            "gitCommitSha": $sha
        }]' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")

    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    ok "플러그인 등록 완료: $plugin_key"

    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    local is_active

        updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] = true' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
        echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
        ok "플러그인 활성화 완료"
    fi
}

install_claude_settings() {
    local src_dir="$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude"

    # 1. 기존 settings.json 백업
    if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        local backup="${SETTINGS_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"

    merge_hooks "$src_dir/hooks/hooks.json"

        ok "output-styles 복사 완료"

        ok "statusline 복사 완료"

    # 5. statusLine 설정 등록
    merge_statusline

    # 6. CLAUDE.md 병합
    merge_claude_md "$src_dir/CLAUDE.md"
}

# --- hooks 머지 (description 기준 중복 방지) ---
merge_hooks() {
    local hooks_file="$1"

    if [ ! -f "$hooks_file" ]; then
        warn "hooks.json을 찾을 수 없습니다: $hooks_file"
        return
    fi

    local src_hooks
    src_hooks=$(jq '.hooks' "$hooks_file")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --argjson src "$src_hooks" '
        reduce ($src | to_entries[]) as $event (
            .;
            reduce $event.value[] as $hook (
                .;
                if ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) | map(.description) | index($hook.description)) then
                    .
                else
                    .hooks[$event.key] = ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) + [$hook])
                end
            )
        )
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "hooks 머지 완료 (중복 건너뜀)"
}

# --- statusLine 설정 등록 ---
merge_statusline() {
    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg cmd "bash $HOME/.claude/statusline-command.sh" '
        .statusLine = {
            "type": "command",
            "command": $cmd
        }
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "statusLine 설정 완료"
}

# --- CLAUDE.md 마커 기반 병합 ---
merge_claude_md() {
    local src_md="$1"
    local target_md="$CLAUDE_DIR/CLAUDE.md"
    local start_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin start ---"
    local end_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin end ---"

    if [ ! -f "$src_md" ]; then
        warn "CLAUDE.md를 찾을 수 없습니다: $src_md"
        return
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$target_md" ]; then
        # 대상 파일이 없으면 새로 생성
        {
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } > "$target_md"
    elif grep -qF "$start_marker" "$target_md"; then
        # 기존 마커 블록을 교체 (멱등성)
        local tmp_block tmp_out
        tmp_block=$(mktemp)
        tmp_out=$(mktemp)
        {
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } > "$tmp_block"

        awk -v start="$start_marker" -v end="$end_marker" -v blockfile="$tmp_block" '
            BEGIN { skip=0 }
            $0 == start {
                while ((getline line < blockfile) > 0) print line
                close(blockfile)
                skip=1
                next
            }
            $0 == end { skip=0; next }
            !skip { print }
        ' "$target_md" > "$tmp_out"
        mv "$tmp_out" "$target_md"
        rm -f "$tmp_block"
    else
        # 마커가 없으면 끝에 추가
        {
            echo ""
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } >> "$target_md"
    fi

    ok "CLAUDE.md 병합 완료"
}

check_env_vars() {

        for var in "${missing[@]}"; do

        echo ""
        info "~/.zshrc 또는 ~/.bashrc에 다음을 추가하세요:"
        echo ""
        echo "  export PLANE_API_KEY=\"your-plane-api-key\""
        echo "  export OUTLINE_API_KEY=\"your-outline-api-key\""
        echo "  export GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"your-grafana-token\""
        echo ""
        info "API 키 발급 방법:"
        echo "  - Plane: https://project.cowave.kr → 프로필 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Outline: https://cowave.wiki.cowave.kr → 설정 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Grafana: http://grafana.danuricorp.com → Administration → Service Accounts"
    else
        ok "모든 환경변수가 설정되어 있습니다."
    fi
}

# --- 메인 ---

     7→# ============================================================
     8→
     9→PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
    10→MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
    11→GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
    12→CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
    13→PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
    14→MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
    15→CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
    16→KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
    17→INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
    18→SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
    19→
    20→RED='\033[0;31m'
    21→GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    22→YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
    23→BLUE='\033[0;34m'
    24→NC='\033[0m'
    25→
    26→info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
    27→ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
    28→warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
    29→error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }
    30→
    31→# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
    32→check_prerequisites() {
    33→    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
    34→        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    35→    fi
    36→    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    37→        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    38→    fi
    39→    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
    40→        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    41→    fi
    42→}
    43→
    44→# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
    45→prepare_dirs() {
    46→    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"
    47→
    48→    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
    49→        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    50→    fi
    51→    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
    52→        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    53→    fi
    54→}
    55→
    56→# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
    57→clone_or_update() {
    58→    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
    59→        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
    60→        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    61→        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
    62→            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
    63→            cd /
    64→            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    65→            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    66→        }
    67→    else
    68→        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
    69→        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    70→        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    71→    fi
    72→    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    73→}
    74→
    75→# --- 캐시 디렉토리에 플러그인 배치 ---
    76→install_to_cache() {
    77→    local commit_sha
    78→    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    79→    local version="$commit_sha"
    80→
    81→    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    82→    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"
    83→
    84→    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    85→    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    86→    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    87→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    88→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    89→    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    90→
    91→    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    92→    echo "$version"
    93→}
    94→
    95→# --- known_marketplaces.json 등록 ---
    96→register_marketplace() {
    97→    local now
    98→    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    99→
   100→    local updated
   101→    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
   102→        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
   103→        --arg now "$now" \
   104→        '.[$name] = {
   105→            "source": {
   106→                "source": "gitlab",
   107→                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
   108→            },
   109→            "installLocation": $location,
   110→            "lastUpdated": $now
   111→        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")

   114→    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
   115→}
   116→
   117→# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
   118→register_plugin() {
   119→    local version="$1"
   120→    local now
   121→    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
   122→    local commit_sha
   123→    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
   124→    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"
   125→
   126→    local updated
   127→    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
   128→        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
   129→        --arg ver "$version" \
   130→        --arg now "$now" \
   131→        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
   132→        '.plugins[$key] = [{
   133→            "scope": "user",
   134→            "installPath": $path,
   135→            "version": $ver,
   136→            "installedAt": $now,
   137→            "lastUpdated": $now,
   138→            "gitCommitSha": $sha
   139→        }]' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")
   140→
   141→    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
   142→    ok "플러그인 등록 완료: $plugin_key"
   143→}
   144→
   145→# --- settings.json에 플러그인 활성화 ---
   146→activate_plugin() {
   147→    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"
   148→
   149→    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
   150→        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
   151→    fi
   152→
   153→    local is_active
   154→    is_active=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$SETTINGS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)
   155→
   156→    if [ "$is_active" = "true" ]; then
   157→        info "이미 활성화되어 있습니다."
   158→    else
   159→        local updated
   160→        updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] = true' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
   161→        echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
   162→        ok "플러그인 활성화 완료"
   163→    fi
   164→}
   165→
   166→# --- Claude settings 자동 설치 ---
   167→install_claude_settings() {
   168→    local src_dir="$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude"
   169→
   170→    # 1. 기존 settings.json 백업
   171→    if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
   172→        local backup="${SETTINGS_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"
   173→        cp "$SETTINGS_FILE" "$backup"
   174→        ok "설정 백업 완료: $backup"
   175→    else
   176→        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
   177→    fi
   178→
   179→    # 2. hooks 머지 (hooks.json → settings.json)
   180→    merge_hooks "$src_dir/hooks/hooks.json"
   181→
   182→    # 3. output-styles 복사
   183→    if [ -d "$src_dir/output-styles" ]; then

   185→        cp -r "$src_dir/output-styles/"* "$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles/" 2>/dev/null || true
   186→        ok "output-styles 복사 완료"
   187→    fi
   188→
   189→    # 4. statusline 복사
   190→    if [ -f "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" ]; then
   191→        cp "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" "$CLAUDE_DIR/statusline-command.sh"
   192→        ok "statusline 복사 완료"
   193→    fi
   194→
   195→    # 5. statusLine 설정 등록
   196→    merge_statusline
   197→
   198→    # 6. CLAUDE.md 병합
   199→    merge_claude_md "$src_dir/CLAUDE.md"
   200→}
   201→
   202→# --- hooks 머지 (description 기준 중복 방지) ---
   203→merge_hooks() {
   204→    local hooks_file="$1"
   205→
   206→    if [ ! -f "$hooks_file" ]; then
   207→        warn "hooks.json을 찾을 수 없습니다: $hooks_file"
   208→        return
   209→    fi
   210→
   211→    local src_hooks
   212→    src_hooks=$(jq '.hooks' "$hooks_file")
   213→
   214→    local updated
   215→    updated=$(jq --argjson src "$src_hooks" '
   216→        reduce ($src | to_entries[]) as $event (
   217→            .;
   218→            reduce $event.value[] as $hook (
   219→                .;
   220→                if ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) | map(.description) | index($hook.description)) then
   221→                    .
   222→                else
   223→                    .hooks[$event.key] = ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) + [$hook])
   224→                end
   225→            )
   226→        )
   227→    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
   228→
   229→    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"

   242→
   243→    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
   244→    ok "statusLine 설정 완료"
   245→}

   248→merge_claude_md() {
   249→    local src_md="$1"
   250→    local target_md="$CLAUDE_DIR/CLAUDE.md"
   251→    local start_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin start ---"
   252→    local end_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin end ---"
   253→
   254→    if [ ! -f "$src_md" ]; then

   263→            cat "$src_md"
   264→            echo "$end_marker"
   265→        } > "$target_md"
   266→    elif grep -qF "$start_marker" "$target_md"; then
   267→        # 기존 마커 블록을 교체 (멱등성)

   270→        tmp_out=$(mktemp)
   271→        {

   274→            echo "$end_marker"
   275→        } > "$tmp_block"
   276→
   277→        awk -v start="$start_marker" -v end="$end_marker" -v blockfile="$tmp_block" '

   289→        rm -f "$tmp_block"

   294→            echo "$start_marker"
   295→            cat "$src_md"
   296→            echo "$end_marker"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 설치 스크립트
# 사내 GitLab에서 플러그인을 설치하고 Claude Code에 등록합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
GITLAB_REPO="https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v git &>/dev/null; then
        error "git이 설치되어 있지 않습니다."
    fi
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
    if ! command -v claude &>/dev/null; then
        warn "claude CLI가 PATH에 없습니다. Claude Code가 설치되어 있는지 확인해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- 디렉토리 준비 ---
prepare_dirs() {
    mkdir -p "$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces" "$PLUGINS_DIR/cache"

    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        echo '{"version":2,"plugins":{}}' > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    fi
}

# --- GitLab에서 플러그인 클론/업데이트 ---
clone_or_update() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.git" ]; then
        info "기존 설치를 업데이트합니다..."
        cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git pull --ff-only origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only origin master 2>/dev/null || {
            warn "pull 실패. 기존 디렉토리를 재설정합니다."
            cd /
            rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
            git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        }
    else
        info "GitLab에서 플러그인을 클론합니다..."
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        git clone "$GITLAB_REPO" "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    fi
    ok "플러그인 소스 준비 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
}

# --- 캐시 디렉토리에 플러그인 배치 ---
install_to_cache() {
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse --short HEAD)
    local version="$commit_sha"

    rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$CACHE_DIR"

    # 레포 루트가 곧 플러그인이므로 전체 복사
    cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.claude-plugin" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    cp "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/.mcp.json" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/skills" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" ]   && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/agents" "$CACHE_DIR/"
    [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" ] && cp -r "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/commands" "$CACHE_DIR/"

    ok "캐시에 설치 완료: $CACHE_DIR" >&2
    echo "$version"
}

# --- known_marketplaces.json 등록 ---
register_marketplace() {
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" \
        --arg location "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        '.[$name] = {
            "source": {
                "source": "gitlab",
                "repo": "consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils"
            },
            "installLocation": $location,
            "lastUpdated": $now
        }' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")

    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    ok "마켓플레이스 등록 완료: $MARKETPLACE_NAME"
}

# --- installed_plugins.json 등록 ---
register_plugin() {
    local version="$1"
    local now
    now=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
    local commit_sha
    commit_sha=$(cd "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" && git rev-parse HEAD)
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" \
        --arg path "$CACHE_DIR" \
        --arg ver "$version" \
        --arg now "$now" \
        --arg sha "$commit_sha" \
        '.plugins[$key] = [{
            "scope": "user",
            "installPath": $path,
            "version": $ver,
            "installedAt": $now,
            "lastUpdated": $now,
            "gitCommitSha": $sha
        }]' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")

    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    ok "플러그인 등록 완료: $plugin_key"
}

# --- settings.json에 플러그인 활성화 ---
activate_plugin() {
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    local is_active
    is_active=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$SETTINGS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ "$is_active" = "true" ]; then
        info "이미 활성화되어 있습니다."
    else
        local updated
        updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] = true' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
        echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
        ok "플러그인 활성화 완료"
    fi
}

# --- Claude settings 자동 설치 ---
install_claude_settings() {
    local src_dir="$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude"

    # 1. 기존 settings.json 백업
    if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        local backup="${SETTINGS_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"
        cp "$SETTINGS_FILE" "$backup"
        ok "설정 백업 완료: $backup"
    else
        echo '{}' > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    fi

    # 2. hooks 머지 (hooks.json → settings.json)
    merge_hooks "$src_dir/hooks/hooks.json"

    # 3. output-styles 복사
    if [ -d "$src_dir/output-styles" ]; then
        mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles"
        cp -r "$src_dir/output-styles/"* "$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles/" 2>/dev/null || true
        ok "output-styles 복사 완료"
    fi

    # 4. statusline 복사
    if [ -f "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" ]; then
        cp "$src_dir/statusline-command.sh" "$CLAUDE_DIR/statusline-command.sh"
        ok "statusline 복사 완료"
    fi

    # 5. statusLine 설정 등록
    merge_statusline

    # 6. CLAUDE.md 병합
    merge_claude_md "$src_dir/CLAUDE.md"
}

# --- hooks 머지 (description 기준 중복 방지) ---
merge_hooks() {
    local hooks_file="$1"

    if [ ! -f "$hooks_file" ]; then
        warn "hooks.json을 찾을 수 없습니다: $hooks_file"
        return
    fi

    local src_hooks
    src_hooks=$(jq '.hooks' "$hooks_file")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --argjson src "$src_hooks" '
        reduce ($src | to_entries[]) as $event (
            .;
            reduce $event.value[] as $hook (
                .;
                if ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) | map(.description) | index($hook.description)) then
                    .
                else
                    .hooks[$event.key] = ((.hooks[$event.key] // []) + [$hook])
                end
            )
        )
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "hooks 머지 완료 (중복 건너뜀)"
}

# --- statusLine 설정 등록 ---
merge_statusline() {
    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg cmd "bash $HOME/.claude/statusline-command.sh" '
        .statusLine = {
            "type": "command",
            "command": $cmd
        }
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "statusLine 설정 완료"
}

# --- CLAUDE.md 마커 기반 병합 ---
merge_claude_md() {
    local src_md="$1"
    local target_md="$CLAUDE_DIR/CLAUDE.md"
    local start_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin start ---"
    local end_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin end ---"

    if [ ! -f "$src_md" ]; then
        warn "CLAUDE.md를 찾을 수 없습니다: $src_md"
        return
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$target_md" ]; then
        # 대상 파일이 없으면 새로 생성
        {
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } > "$target_md"
    elif grep -qF "$start_marker" "$target_md"; then
        # 기존 마커 블록을 교체 (멱등성)
        local tmp_block tmp_out
        tmp_block=$(mktemp)
        tmp_out=$(mktemp)
        {
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } > "$tmp_block"

        awk -v start="$start_marker" -v end="$end_marker" -v blockfile="$tmp_block" '
            BEGIN { skip=0 }
            $0 == start {
                while ((getline line < blockfile) > 0) print line
                close(blockfile)
                skip=1
                next
            }
            $0 == end { skip=0; next }
            !skip { print }
        ' "$target_md" > "$tmp_out"
        mv "$tmp_out" "$target_md"
        rm -f "$tmp_block"
    else
        # 마커가 없으면 끝에 추가
        {
            echo ""
            echo "$start_marker"
            cat "$src_md"
            echo "$end_marker"
        } >> "$target_md"
    fi

    ok "CLAUDE.md 병합 완료"
}

# --- 환경변수 확인 ---
check_env_vars() {
    echo ""
    info "환경변수 설정을 확인합니다..."

    local missing=()

    [ -z "${PLANE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("PLANE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${OUTLINE_API_KEY:-}" ] && missing+=("OUTLINE_API_KEY")
    [ -z "${GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN:-}" ] && missing+=("GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN")

    if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        warn "다음 환경변수가 설정되지 않았습니다:"
        for var in "${missing[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        info "~/.zshrc 또는 ~/.bashrc에 다음을 추가하세요:"
        echo ""
        echo "  export PLANE_API_KEY=\"your-plane-api-key\""
        echo "  export OUTLINE_API_KEY=\"your-outline-api-key\""
        echo "  export GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=\"your-grafana-token\""
        echo ""
        info "API 키 발급 방법:"
        echo "  - Plane: https://project.cowave.kr → 프로필 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Outline: https://cowave.wiki.cowave.kr → 설정 → API 토큰"
        echo "  - Grafana: http://grafana.danuricorp.com → Administration → Service Accounts"
    else
        ok "모든 환경변수가 설정되어 있습니다."
    fi
}

# --- 메인 ---
main() {
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Cowave Claude Plugin 설치"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    check_prerequisites
    prepare_dirs
    clone_or_update

    local version
    version=$(install_to_cache)

    register_marketplace
    register_plugin "$version"
    activate_plugin
    install_claude_settings
    check_env_vars

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}설치 완료!${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
    info "Claude Code를 재시작하면 플러그인이 활성화됩니다."
    info "사용 가능한 기능:"
    echo "  - /issue-tracker      : Plane 이슈 트래커 연동"
    echo "  - /document-lastest   : Outline 위키 자동 문서화"
    echo "  - /tdd                : TDD 워크플로우"
    echo "  - /arch-review        : 아키텍처 리뷰"
    echo "  - /perf-review        : 성능 리뷰"
    echo "  - /e2e                : E2E 테스트"
    echo "  - MCP: plane, outline, grafana 서버 연동"
    echo ""
}

main "$@"

1→#!/bin/bash
     2→set -euo pipefail
     3→
     4→# ============================================================
     5→# Cowave Claude Plugin 제거 스크립트
     6→# setup.sh로 설치된 플러그인을 정리하고 제거합니다.
     7→# ============================================================
     8→
     9→PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
    10→MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
    11→CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
    12→PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
    13→MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
    14→CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
    15→KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
    16→INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
    17→SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
    18→HOOKS_JSON=""
    19→
    20→RED='\033[0;31m'
    21→GREEN='\033[0;32m'
    22→YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
    23→BLUE='\033[0;34m'
    24→NC='\033[0m'
    25→
    26→info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
    27→ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
    28→warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
    29→error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }
    30→
    31→# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
    32→check_prerequisites() {
    33→    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    34→        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    35→    fi
    36→}
    37→
    38→# --- hooks.json 경로 탐색 ---
    39→find_hooks_json() {
    40→    # 캐시에서 먼저 찾고, 없으면 마켓플레이스 디렉토리, 없으면 스크립트 옆 경로에서 탐색
    41→    local script_dir
    42→    script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    43→
    44→    local candidates=(
    45→        "$CACHE_DIR/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
    46→        "$CACHE_DIR/.claude-plugin/../claude/hooks/hooks.json"
    47→        "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
    48→        "$script_dir/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
    49→    )
    50→
    51→    for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
    52→        if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then
    53→            HOOKS_JSON="$candidate"
    54→            return
    55→        fi
    56→    done
    57→}
    58→
    59→# --- 캐시 디렉토리 제거 ---
    60→remove_cache() {
    61→    if [ -d "$CACHE_DIR" ]; then
    62→        rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
    63→        ok "캐시 디렉토리 제거 완료: $CACHE_DIR"
    64→    else
    65→        warn "캐시 디렉토리가 존재하지 않습니다: $CACHE_DIR"
    66→    fi
    67→
    68→    # 상위 마켓플레이스 캐시 디렉토리가 비었으면 정리
    69→    local cache_marketplace_dir="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
    70→    if [ -d "$cache_marketplace_dir" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A "$cache_marketplace_dir" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    71→        rmdir "$cache_marketplace_dir"
    72→        info "빈 캐시 마켓플레이스 디렉토리 정리: $cache_marketplace_dir"
    73→    fi
    74→}
    75→
    76→# --- 마켓플레이스 디렉토리 제거 ---
    77→remove_marketplace() {
    78→    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" ]; then
    79→        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# Cowave Claude Plugin 제거 스크립트
# setup.sh로 설치된 플러그인을 정리하고 제거합니다.
# ============================================================

PLUGIN_NAME="agents-utils"
MARKETPLACE_NAME="cowave-plugins"
CLAUDE_DIR="$HOME/.claude"
PLUGINS_DIR="$CLAUDE_DIR/plugins"
MARKETPLACE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/marketplaces/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
CACHE_DIR="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME/$PLUGIN_NAME"
KNOWN_MARKETPLACES="$PLUGINS_DIR/known_marketplaces.json"
INSTALLED_PLUGINS="$PLUGINS_DIR/installed_plugins.json"
SETTINGS_FILE="$CLAUDE_DIR/settings.json"
HOOKS_JSON=""

RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

info()  { echo -e "${BLUE}[INFO]${NC} $1"; }
ok()    { echo -e "${GREEN}[OK]${NC} $1"; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"; }
error() { echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"; exit 1; }

# --- 사전 조건 확인 ---
check_prerequisites() {
    if ! command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        error "jq가 설치되어 있지 않습니다. brew install jq 로 설치해주세요."
    fi
}

# --- hooks.json 경로 탐색 ---
find_hooks_json() {
    # 캐시에서 먼저 찾고, 없으면 마켓플레이스 디렉토리, 없으면 스크립트 옆 경로에서 탐색
    local script_dir
    script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

    local candidates=(
        "$CACHE_DIR/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
        "$CACHE_DIR/.claude-plugin/../claude/hooks/hooks.json"
        "$MARKETPLACE_DIR/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
        "$script_dir/claude/hooks/hooks.json"
    )

    for candidate in "${candidates[@]}"; do
        if [ -f "$candidate" ]; then
            HOOKS_JSON="$candidate"
            return
        fi
    done
}

# --- 캐시 디렉토리 제거 ---
remove_cache() {
    if [ -d "$CACHE_DIR" ]; then
        rm -rf "$CACHE_DIR"
        ok "캐시 디렉토리 제거 완료: $CACHE_DIR"
    else
        warn "캐시 디렉토리가 존재하지 않습니다: $CACHE_DIR"
    fi

    # 상위 마켓플레이스 캐시 디렉토리가 비었으면 정리
    local cache_marketplace_dir="$PLUGINS_DIR/cache/$MARKETPLACE_NAME"
    if [ -d "$cache_marketplace_dir" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A "$cache_marketplace_dir" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        rmdir "$cache_marketplace_dir"
        info "빈 캐시 마켓플레이스 디렉토리 정리: $cache_marketplace_dir"
    fi
}

# --- 마켓플레이스 디렉토리 제거 ---
remove_marketplace() {
    if [ -d "$MARKETPLACE_DIR" ]; then
        rm -rf "$MARKETPLACE_DIR"
        ok "마켓플레이스 디렉토리 제거 완료: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    else
        warn "마켓플레이스 디렉토리가 존재하지 않습니다: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    fi
}

# --- installed_plugins.json에서 항목 제거 ---
remove_installed_plugin() {
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" ]; then
        warn "installed_plugins.json이 존재하지 않습니다."
        return
    fi

    local has_key
    has_key=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ -z "$has_key" ]; then
        warn "installed_plugins.json에 $plugin_key 항목이 없습니다."
        return
    fi

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" 'del(.plugins[$key])' "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS")
    echo "$updated" > "$INSTALLED_PLUGINS"
    ok "installed_plugins.json에서 $plugin_key 제거 완료"
}

# --- known_marketplaces.json에서 항목 제거 ---
remove_known_marketplace() {
    if [ ! -f "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" ]; then
        warn "known_marketplaces.json이 존재하지 않습니다."
        return
    fi

    local has_key
    has_key=$(jq -r --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" '.[$name] // empty' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ -z "$has_key" ]; then
        warn "known_marketplaces.json에 $MARKETPLACE_NAME 항목이 없습니다."
        return
    fi

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg name "$MARKETPLACE_NAME" 'del(.[$name])' "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES")
    echo "$updated" > "$KNOWN_MARKETPLACES"
    ok "known_marketplaces.json에서 $MARKETPLACE_NAME 제거 완료"
}

# --- settings.json에서 플러그인 비활성화 ---
deactivate_plugin() {
    local plugin_key="${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME}"

    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        warn "settings.json이 존재하지 않습니다."
        return
    fi

    local has_key
    has_key=$(jq -r --arg key "$plugin_key" '.plugins[$key] // empty' "$SETTINGS_FILE" 2>/dev/null)

    if [ -z "$has_key" ]; then
        warn "settings.json에 플러그인 $plugin_key 항목이 없습니다."
        return
    fi

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --arg key "$plugin_key" 'del(.plugins[$key])' "$SETTINGS_FILE")
    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "settings.json에서 플러그인 비활성화 완료"
}

# --- settings.json에서 플러그인이 등록한 hooks 제거 ---
remove_hooks() {
    if [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        warn "settings.json이 존재하지 않습니다."
        return
    fi

    if [ -z "$HOOKS_JSON" ] || [ ! -f "$HOOKS_JSON" ]; then
        warn "hooks.json을 찾을 수 없습니다. hooks 제거를 건너뜁니다."
        return
    fi

    # hooks.json에서 모든 description 목록을 추출
    local descriptions
    descriptions=$(jq '[.hooks | to_entries[] | .value[] | .description]' "$HOOKS_JSON")

    local updated
    updated=$(jq --argjson descs "$descriptions" '
        if .hooks then
            .hooks |= with_entries(
                .value |= map(select(.description as $d | ($descs | index($d)) | not))
            )
            | .hooks |= with_entries(select(.value | length > 0))
        else
            .
        end
    ' "$SETTINGS_FILE")

    echo "$updated" > "$SETTINGS_FILE"
    ok "settings.json에서 플러그인 hooks 제거 완료"
}

# --- output-styles 파일 제거 ---
remove_output_styles() {
    local styles_dir="$CLAUDE_DIR/output-styles"
    local target_file="$styles_dir/learning-plus.md"

    if [ -f "$target_file" ]; then
        rm -f "$target_file"
        ok "output-styles 파일 제거 완료: learning-plus.md"
    else
        warn "output-styles 파일이 존재하지 않습니다: $target_file"
    fi

    # output-styles 디렉토리가 비었으면 정리
    if [ -d "$styles_dir" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A "$styles_dir" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        rmdir "$styles_dir"
        info "빈 output-styles 디렉토리 정리"
    fi
}

# --- CLAUDE.md에서 플러그인 마커 블록 제거 ---
remove_claude_md_block() {
    local target_md="$CLAUDE_DIR/CLAUDE.md"
    local start_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin start ---"
    local end_marker="# --- agents-utils plugin end ---"

    if [ ! -f "$target_md" ]; then
        warn "CLAUDE.md가 존재하지 않습니다."
        return
    fi

    if ! grep -qF "$start_marker" "$target_md"; then
        warn "CLAUDE.md에 플러그인 마커 블록이 없습니다."
        return
    fi

    local tmp_out
    tmp_out=$(mktemp)

    awk -v start="$start_marker" -v end="$end_marker" '
        BEGIN { skip=0 }
        $0 == start { skip=1; next }
        $0 == end   { skip=0; next }
        !skip       { print }
    ' "$target_md" > "$tmp_out"

    # 마커 블록 앞에 추가된 빈 줄 정리 (파일 끝 연속 빈 줄 제거)
    sed -e :a -e '/^\n*$/{$d;N;ba' -e '}' "$tmp_out" > "$target_md"
    rm -f "$tmp_out"

    # CLAUDE.md가 비었으면 파일 자체를 제거하지 않음 (사용자 콘텐츠가 있을 수 있음)
    ok "CLAUDE.md에서 플러그인 마커 블록 제거 완료"
}

# --- 메인 ---
main() {
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Cowave Claude Plugin 제거"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""

    check_prerequisites

    info "다음 항목이 제거됩니다:"
    echo "  - 캐시 디렉토리: $CACHE_DIR"
    echo "  - 마켓플레이스 디렉토리: $MARKETPLACE_DIR"
    echo "  - installed_plugins.json의 ${PLUGIN_NAME}@${MARKETPLACE_NAME} 항목"
    echo "  - known_marketplaces.json의 $MARKETPLACE_NAME 항목"
    echo "  - settings.json의 플러그인 활성화 항목"
    echo "  - settings.json의 플러그인 hooks"
    echo "  - CLAUDE.md의 플러그인 마커 블록"
    echo "  - output-styles/learning-plus.md"
    echo ""
    warn "statusline-command.sh 및 statusLine 설정은 유지됩니다."
    echo ""

    read -rp "계속 진행하시겠습니까? (y/N): " confirm
    if [[ ! "$confirm" =~ ^[yY]$ ]]; then
        info "제거를 취소합니다."
        exit 0
    fi

    echo ""

    # hooks.json 경로를 미리 탐색 (캐시 제거 전에 수행)
    find_hooks_json

    # settings.json 백업
    if [ -f "$SETTINGS_FILE" ]; then
        local backup="${SETTINGS_FILE}.bak.$(date +%s)"
        cp "$SETTINGS_FILE" "$backup"
        ok "설정 백업 완료: $backup"
    fi

    remove_hooks
    deactivate_plugin
    remove_installed_plugin
    remove_known_marketplace
    remove_output_styles
    remove_claude_md_block
    remove_cache
    remove_marketplace

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo -e "  ${GREEN}제거 완료!${NC}"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo ""
    info "Claude Code를 재시작하면 변경사항이 적용됩니다."
    echo ""
}

# Agents-utils

사내 AI 코딩 에이전트(Claude Code, Copilot CLI 등)에서 공통으로 사용하는 에이전트, 커맨드, 스킬, 훅, MCP 서버 설정을 모아둔 저장소입니다.
`setup.sh` 한 번 실행으로 모든 설정이 자동 설치됩니다.

---

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. 저장소 클론
git clone https://labs.cowave.kr/consumer-commerce-dev/search/techlab/agent-utils.git

# 2. 환경변수 설정 (~/.zshrc 또는 ~/.bashrc에 추가)
export PLANE_API_KEY="your-plane-api-key"
export OUTLINE_API_KEY="your-outline-api-key"
export GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN="your-grafana-token"

# 3. 설치 실행
cd agent-utils && ./setup.sh
```

---

| 도구 | 용도 | 설치 방법 |
|------|------|-----------|
